verdict.rationale: No language SDK or client library is documented. The closest official programmatic surfaces are an HTTP API with a downloadable OpenAPI contract for request/response schemas, which enables client generation, and an npm-installed CLI with a versioned `--json` output envelope (`schemaVersion` + `data`) whose input schemas can be printed. Hands-on probes confirmed the CLI runs and the schemas print, so you can build against Ultrametric only through generated clients or by shelling out to the CLI. missing for 10: an official SDK/client library in any language, SDK documentation and examples, independent corroboration of SDK use.
